author: Puysegur
body:
I've had this map for a while now, but because it uses 1.8 blocks I've been waiting to release it. I figured I may as well release some images so people can give some feedback on what needs to be improved.

-3 monuments
-pockets of iron and diamond
-2 middle islands
-an extra spaceship per team

The map has an emphasis on verticality. It would have the max amount of players possible.

More images: http://imgur.com/a/UgMY3
